verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents official SDKs: self-contained libraries with instructions, examples, and project files. They are described only for mobile application developers, and the rest of the integration is the raw REST API. Missing for 10: server-side/backend language SDKs, SDK coverage of the core Checkout/Sale/Decision APIs, version or language detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: SDKs provide mobile application developers with self-contained libraries for implementing Signifyd. Each SDK include instructions, examples, and project files to allow you to quickly add Signifyd to an existing project.
